input.prompt: A single still life for the end of an engagement invitation: a round brass plate holding fresh betel leaves, a bunch of small bananas, a coconut, a little mound of turmeric and a small heap of red kumkum, strings of jasmine, a few marigolds and rose petals, two simple gold rings resting on the betel leaves. Seen from a gentle three-quarter angle, isolated on pure white background (#ffffff) with only a very soft shadow. Match the reference painting's exact style: delicate hand-painted watercolor on textured cold-press ivory paper, soft blush-pink, peach and warm cream washes with gentle blooms, fine sepia ink linework, subtle antique-gold highlights, airy and romantic luxury Indian wedding invitation artwork, soft diffuse daylight. No people, no text, no letters, no lamps, no candles, no diyas, no fire, no street lights.
